messages:
diego (acct-owner): Quick heads-up — ran the post-onboard privacy scan for NimbusHealth. Two items flagged in the consent matrix; SOC2 evidence bucket shows 'missing' for collection consent on patient_notes and audit_events. Can we triage?
maya (cs): Ack. Linking their onboarding ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-4123 — they uploaded DPA but consent CSV looks incomplete.
onboard-bot: Automated scan: consent-matrix.csv -> 2 missing rows (patient_notes, audit_events). Evidence risk: medium. See /scans/4398765432/result
jordan (security): What format were the consent records expected in? Are these user opt-ins or system-level processing clauses?
ben (eng): Those two are system-generated events (audit_events) and clinician free-text (patient_notes). Consent should be documented as a processing clause tied to dataflow, not per-user opt-in. I can pull schema and sample rows.
rachel (legal): DPA requires documented lawful basis + retention for PHI-adjacent telemetry. If product treats patient_notes as potentially re-identifiable, we need explicit mapping in the consent matrix. We should avoid calling it "missing" if there is a retention policy elsewhere — just needs linkage.
maya (cs): Actionable plan: 1) Ben to attach the dataflow snippet and sample retention entries; 2) Diego to confirm whether Nimbus uses client-managed consent or our hosted consent flow; 3) Jordan to verify SOC2 evidence acceptance criteria. I can draft customer-facing language once we have attachments.
diego (acct-owner): Confirmed — Nimbus uses hosted consent service for user-facing items, but processing clauses for audit_events were handled in onboarding notes (freeform). Seems that didn't make it into the structured consent matrix.
ben (eng): Pasted snippet of relevant schema and retention lines: ```
/collections/patient_notes: retention=7y, classification=highly_sensitive
/streams/audit_events: retention=90d, classification=system_telemetry
```
ben (eng): Uploading the structured snippet to the ticket now.
onboard-bot: File uploaded: consent-snippet-4398765432.yaml (size 8.7 KB)
jordan (security): Thanks. For SOC2, the auditor wants an explicit link from the consent matrix row to a supporting artifact (policy or schema). The snippet + ticket link should suffice, but we need customer sign-off that this covers DPA clause 4.1.
rachel (legal): Diego — can you ask the customer to sign off on the two rows? Suggested copy: "We confirm that patient_notes and audit_events are processed under lawful basis X and retained per the attached policy." I can refine.
diego (acct-owner): I'll ping their CISO and PM. @maya please keep this open — if they decline we may need an exception or a remediation plan.
maya (cs): Noted. I'll schedule a 15-min sync with payer-side PM tomorrow. If we get sign-off, I will update the consent matrix CSV and attach the sign-off PDF.
jordan (security): Also adding a quick checklist for SOC2 prep: - artifact link in matrix - signed customer statement - retention proof (db dump of retention config or policy) - mapping in dataflow diagram.
maya (cs): Putting checklist into ticket and assigning: ben -> attach config (due EOD), diego -> customer sign-off (due +48h), jordan -> SOC2 acceptance (due +72h), rachel -> sign-off copy (in flight).
diego (acct-owner): Thanks all. If anything blocks, tag me. Otherwise I'll update account health to 'onboarding: remediation in progress' and note renewal risk as low but flagged until closed. :white_check_mark:
maya (cs): I'll follow up after the sync and paste the signed statement here. Thanks team :pray:
